Pipe: Create a new pipe. If `path` is a number, it is treated as a file descriptor to open. If it is a string, it is treated as a path to connect to.
connecting: Whether the pipe is currently connecting.
pending: Whether the pipe has not yet connected.
readyState: The current state of the pipe. One of `'open'`, `'readOnly'`, `'writeOnly'`, or `'opening'`.
open: Open the pipe on the given file descriptor.
connect: Connect the pipe to `path`. `onconnect` is called when the connection is established.
write: Write `chunk` to the pipe. If `handle` is given and the pipe was created with `ipc: true`, the handle is transferred to the receiver alongside the chunk. `handle` must implement the [`IPCAcceptable`](#ipc-handle-passing) protocol.
accept: Accept a pending handle into `target`. `target` must implement the [`IPCAcceptable`](#ipc-handle-passing) protocol. Call this synchronously from the `'handle'` event listener. Throws `INVALID_IPC_TARGET` if `target` does not implement the protocol.
ref: Ref the pipe, preventing the process from exiting.
unref: Unref the pipe, allowing the process to exit.
Pipe.createServer: Create a new pipe server. `server` extends <https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-events>.
address: Returns the bound path, or `null` if the server is not listening.
listen: Start listening for connections on `path`. `backlog` defaults to `511`.
close: Close the server. No new connections will be accepted. The server emits `close` after all existing connections have ended.
Pipe.createConnection: Create a new pipe and connect it to `path`. Shorthand for `new Pipe(options).connect(path, options, onconnect)`.
Pipe.pipe: Returns `[read, write]`, a pair of file descriptors connected to each other.
